items.hed: Texans play the Chargers Sunday at SoFi Stadium
items.insight: The club's transactions page lists two Nov. 2 entries. One signs defensive tackle Naquan Jones, signs Joshua Pitsenberger to the practice squad, waives Jaden Crumedy, and releases Deuce Vaughn. A later line the same day signs Crumedy and Daniel Sobkowicz to the practice squad and releases Kyonte Hamilton and Zaire Mitchell-Paden. Houston's news page points to Sunday, Nov. 8, at SoFi Stadium, for the ways to watch the Chargers game.

items.hed: Rockets host Minnesota tonight at Toyota Center, 8:30 p.m. ET
items.insight: NBA.com still lists the game status as 8:30 p.m. ET, which is 7:30 p.m. in Houston. The page has not posted a final. Tipoff has not arrived, so there is no score to print.

items.hed: Astros' Monday roster moves stand: Correa activated, Reifert acquired
items.insight: MLB's transaction log shows no Houston moves dated Nov. 3 or Nov. 4. Monday's log still has Carlos Correa, Mike Burrows, and Brandon Walter activated from the 60-day injured list, Evan Reifert acquired from Tampa Bay for cash, Roddery Muñoz and César Salazar selected from Sugar Land, and Jake Meyers sent outright to Sugar Land.
